announcement: For your celebrations · Mohali, Kharar, Chandigarh & Panchkula
heroTitle: Every celebration deserves a little magic.
heroDescription: Beautiful cakes. Thoughtful details. Made for your moments, by _baking_co.
orderNotice: Availability, final price, delivery charges and payment arrangements are confirmed on WhatsApp. Sending an enquiry does not confirm an order.
promoText: From a first birthday to a golden anniversary, tell us what you are celebrating. We will help you make it personal.
about: Welcome to _baking_co. Explore our cake collection and tell us about your celebration. For a custom design, share your colours, theme and inspiration with us.
hours: Contact us to confirm collection timings.
deliveryText: Delivery is available by enquiry in Mohali, Kharar, Chandigarh, Panchkula and nearby areas. We confirm availability, delivery charges and time before accepting your order.
refundText: Please discuss cancellation and refund terms with us before confirming your custom cake order.
privacyText: We use the name, phone number, address and celebration details you submit to respond to your enquiry and fulfil an agreed order. Contact us on WhatsApp to ask about your submitted details.
termsText: Website enquiries are requests, not confirmed orders. Cake design, ingredients, allergens, delivery, final price and payment must be agreed with _baking_co before confirmation.
